content: This document contains two tables that provide data on fertility rates across countries and territories. The first table is sourced from the CIA World Factbook and ranks sovereign states by their total fertility rate (TFR). The TFR represents the expected number of children born per woman during her reproductive years, based on age-specific fertility rate data from 2007. It is important to note that some countries may not be included in this list if they were not fully recognized as independent nations at the time of the census. The second table presents a ranking of countries by their total fertility rate, based on data from the 2006 revision of the United Nations World Population Prospects report. This data covers the periods 2000–2005 and 2005–2010, using the medium assumption for projections. Only countries or territories with a population of 100,000 or more as of 2007 are included in this table. The rankings are specifically based on the 2005–2010 period.
